name: services-device-peripherals
description: Hardware only some machines have: fingerprint readers, scanners, graphics tablets, game controllers. Each pulls in daemons a host without the device has no use for — and biometrics can affect whether you can log in, which is why this is never taken by default.
optInReason: biometrics can affect whether you can log in, and the rest are daemons for hardware most hosts do not have
